Documents whether the shell's "Hub updated — it will use the new version next time it opens." toast (index.html:1695) shows on a first visit, when nothing was updated. It does in most WebKit runs (a race between clients.claim and the installed statechange); when it does not, go() drops the worker and its cache and reloads (up to twice) and logs that to the manifest, so a capture without the toast is possible but rare.
